title: XmasZap - Christmas arcade: elves defend the tree. Made with AI, brought to you by #PlaygamaMCP, fine-tuned by me
author: 4Fanoffstudio
selftext:
XmasZap is a Christmas arcade game: elves defend the Christmas tree from goblins, snowmen and pirate walruses. 35 levels in 5 towns, 5 bosses, decorate your own tree between fights. Runs right in the browser on PC and phones.

How it was made: AI agents (Claude) did the code in the Defold engine, 3D models and animation in Blender, plus music, sound and voices. I directed and tested everything. Playable here: [https://playgama.ai/play/oxsxmvzc5lsmwj](https://playgama.ai/play/oxsxmvzc5lsmwj)

Feedback is very welcome, especially on difficulty.
